metadata.title: Micron Stock: Why Its Workers Are Threatening to Strike<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron’s Workers Are Threatening to Strike. What It Means for the Stock.
Micron booming memory-chip business has pushed its stock higher and higher over the past year, and workers are now demanding a larger share of the profits.
